purpose: Remove P0644's zero-tensor geometry advantage by refitting identical conventional lens geometry for every lambda and selecting only with internal cross-validation on the 15 spent training images.

cross_validation.construction: deterministic source-family-stratified round robin over the 15 P0601 training images; every held image leaves at least one other image from its source family in fit
cross_validation.selection_metric: root-count-complete pooled exact radial RMS across all CV predictions

claim_boundary: All RX J2129 images remain spent; internal CV can select a development constant but supplies no external validation.
A source family retains at least one image in every fold so its source position can be inferred; this is not leave-family-out prediction.
The 25 kpc common smoothing is fixed before scoring and is not selected from lens residuals.
The selected lambda must transfer unchanged to other spent clusters before it is eligible for a P0640 freeze.
A matched generic multipole control remains mandatory before interpreting an improvement as new gravity.
